name: Cross-Agent Context Propagation
description: Compromised context (instructions, poisoned memory, or tool output) crossing an agent boundary — via delegation, shared memory, or agent-to-agent messaging — so that a threat introduced in one agent influences others and amplifies across a workflow.
differs: Not a fresh ingress technique: it describes *propagation* of an existing compromise across trust domains. May be merged into propagation_scope/propagation_path attributes if telemetry shows no distinct detection or mitigation needs.
